name: fuck-pdf
description: fuck pdf - a free, open-source PDF viewer and editor. No subscriptions. No paywalls.
author: fuck pdf contributors

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build-updater.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 && node scripts/checksums.cjs
scripts.test:ui: xvfb-run -a node test/ui/doc.mjs && xvfb-run -a node test/ui/edit-links.mjs
scripts.test:win: cd dist/win-unpacked && WINEDEBUG=-all ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 wine "fuck pdf.exe" ../../test/win-smoke.mjs > ../../test/out/win-smoke.log 2>&1; cat ../../test/out/win-smoke.json
